examples.input_condition: Numeric activity has no explicit unit
examples.expected_action: Reject until activity_unit matches the factor denominator

examples.input_condition: Spend-based multiplier replaces unavailable activity data

examples.expected_action: Persist factor year, source version and reporting period

examples.input_condition: Annual result changes after a new factor release
examples.expected_action: Review official major changes before assigning operational cause
examples.risk_prevented: Method revision presented as real change

examples.expected_action: Require publication, factor, unit, scope and methodology lineage

examples.input_condition: Provisional and final estimates share a year
examples.expected_action: Keep stage and vintage distinct with an explicit revision link
Require IPCC AR5 GWP framework and gas-specific mass

examples.input_condition: Biogenic combustion CO2 enters a territorial energy total
examples.expected_action: Keep it outside where land-use carbon-stock reporting applies

examples.input_condition: International aviation or shipping enters territorial totals
examples.expected_action: Exclude unless a different official measure is explicitly selected

examples.input_condition: Transport involves UK operators abroad or foreign operators in the UK
examples.expected_action: Apply residence ownership rather than physical-location boundary

examples.input_condition: Consumption accounting includes imports or exports
examples.expected_action: Include UK-consumed supply chains and exclude exported UK production

examples.input_condition: Latest footprint, residence and territorial releases are compared
A measurement has an uncertainty assessment
examples.expected_action: Store measurement uncertainty separately from provenance confidence

examples.input_condition: Emissions pass through multiple meters or calculations
examples.expected_action: Require data-flow description, risk assessment and controls

examples.input_condition: A factor depends on sampling or laboratory analysis
examples.expected_action: Persist sampling plan, method, period and laboratory provenance

examples.input_condition: CEMS, automated or periodic results coexist
examples.expected_action: Apply permit and official method hierarchy before reconciliation

examples.input_condition: Ultra-small emitter exceeds 2500 tCO2e in a scheme year
examples.expected_action: Flag threshold breach and trigger regulator-notification workflow
